verdict.rationale: Supabase's automations (Cron, Database Webhooks, Queues, Edge Functions) are defined in Postgres or as deployable code, so they can be versioned and reviewed indirectly. The tools for this are SQL migrations (`list_migrations`/`apply_migration`), branching with per-PR preview environments, and branch merge/reset. Rollback exists only at the database level through daily backups and PITR, and community users call the migration workflow a weakness, though that is criticism rather than a concrete failure. Missing for 10: first-class version history and rollback for cron jobs, webhooks and Edge Function deployments; documentation tying automation definitions to migrations/branch review; granular, non-whole-database rollback; independent hands-on corroboration.
